decisions.reason: The address autocomplete web service draws on the firm's long-built address and grid-area databases and its web-service know-how, so it fits the platform direction and is cheap to maintain.

The Austrian gas grid fee database extends the firm's core grid-fee data expertise into a neighbouring regulated market, but its smaller customer base makes it somewhat more vulnerable to being dropped.
Peak load window determination is a regulated calculation task that rests directly on the firm's analytical and network-operator knowledge, so the firm can interpret results and keep improving it.
The end-customer tariff database is central to the firm's market-data business and serves energy suppliers, which strongly supports keeping it.
Custom web services apply the firm's software development and data center capabilities flexibly and support its move toward modular SaaS and standardized data exchange.
The postal code lookup service relies on the firm's established geographic and grid-area data and complements its other data web services at low ongoing cost.
